en: The parser fails on the second pass because the token stream is not reset between documents.
I need to check whether the cache returns a stale entry after the model is switched.
This is an edge case where the worker exits before the drain loop observes the outstanding call.
The race condition only appears when two requests arrive within the same millisecond.
Reading the whole file into memory is wasteful here, since we only need the first hundred lines.
The pipeline stalls because the previous stage never signals that it is finished.
Every fragment is translated on its own, so the model never sees the sentence that came before.
If the endpoint refuses the range request, the download has to start over from the beginning.
The settings file is written through a temporary file so a partial write cannot be read back.
I should verify that the checksum matches before moving the file into place.
The decoder repeats the same clause until the token budget runs out, which means the output is unusable.
Because the native call is synchronous, every inference blocks the event loop for about two hundred milliseconds.
The user asked for a sidebar entry, so the panel has to be registered under two slots that share one identifier.
Registering only the icon leaves a button that cannot be opened, and registering only the panel leaves a panel nothing can reach.
The default bundle cannot be removed because the plugin ships with those weights and has nothing else to fall back to.
Switching precision rebuilds the worker, because the old weights would otherwise stay resident.
A long sentence is cut into pieces of roughly one hundred and eighty characters before it is sent to the model.
Abbreviations such as e.g. and i.e. must not be treated as the end of a sentence.
The guard recognises a loop by looking for a short substring that repeats many times in a row.
When the guard fires, the English sentence is shown instead, since a visible loop is worse than untranslated text.
The retry uses a stricter repetition penalty and forbids even two-token repeats.
Measured on the same sample, the whole paragraph took about eight seconds and looped, while sentence by sentence took five.
Nothing in this path writes to the session log, so a translation can never change what the model actually said.
The cache key includes the model identifier and the glossary, otherwise an edited term would keep serving the old rendering.
Short answers are not judged on length, because a two-word reply is legitimately shorter than its source.
The style element is looked up by a data attribute, so a hot reload replaces the rules instead of appending a second copy.
Colours come from theme variables, and a variable that does not exist silently disables the whole declaration.
The panel reads and writes the same settings file as the plugin page, so both surfaces stay consistent.
A zero-argument method must be called with no arguments at all, because the gateway checks the argument count.
The field is volatile, which means reading it returns a holder rather than the value itself.
I want to confirm the memory footprint stays flat across a hundred sentences before claiming the plugin is cheap.
The model loads in about one second from disk and answers the first sentence in half a second after that.
More threads did not help, and the graphics card was slower than the processor for a model this small.
Batching two sentences gave no speedup, and batching four produced repeated clauses in the output.
The downloader falls back to the mirror because the primary endpoint fails every request from this machine.
Progress is reported per byte, and the panel polls the status method twice a second while a transfer runs.
An interrupted download resumes from where it stopped instead of starting over.
The identifier is masked before translation, so the model cannot translate a command name into a Chinese word.
Masking every technical term made the output worse, because three placeholders in one sentence make the model reorder clauses.
Concept repairs run on the Chinese side and only fix renderings that were actually observed to be wrong.
The glossary accepts one term per line, and an equals sign pins a specific rendering.
The worker is spawned on the first sentence that needs translation, so a session that never expands its reasoning pays nothing.
Teardown waits for the outstanding native call to finish, because terminating the thread mid-inference crashes the process.
The request is refused when the model is configured but its weights are not on disk.
I would rather keep the English sentence than show a translation that reads like a rendering bug.
The whole correction pass costs microseconds, so it runs on every request instead of being cached.
Joining wrapped lines back together is what makes a wrapped paragraph translate as one context instead of many fragments.
If the source ends with a comma, the next line is almost certainly the rest of the same sentence.
The result is checked before the placeholders are restored, because a restored address would look like a repetition.
Two failures in a row means the model cannot handle the sentence, and the reader gets the original text.
Run `npm test` before committing, and check that the grep output contains no warnings.
The script prints the BLEU score, which dropped because the tokenizer was not updated.
The worker calls onnxruntime-node directly, so the ONNX runtime version must match the prebuilt binary.
Set dtype to q8 to load the quantized weights instead of the full precision ones.
The function returns a Promise that resolves to the translation text, and rejects on abort.
The JSON schema declares additionalProperties false, so unknown keys are rejected.
Marian exposes an encoder and a merged decoder, and the merged decoder keeps its own cache.
The LRU cache holds five thousand entries, keyed by a hash of the source text.
The remote method must not be named remove, because that name is taken by the namespace service.
A TypeScript declaration would be nicer, but the runtime only reads the prototype marker.
The panel polls status every five hundred milliseconds while the download is in progress.
Set DSH_OFFLINE_TRANSLATOR_MODEL_ROOT to point the plugin at a different weights directory.
The CLI reports an ignored build script for protobufjs, but the prebuilt binaries are already present.
Use the useCallback hook so the effect does not refetch on every render.
The function returns ok false with an error object instead of throwing, so callers must check the flag.
Open `src/index.ts` and change the default export to the controller class.
The failing line is `const value = map.get(key)!`, which asserts non-null without checking.
Replace `worker.postMessage(...)` with a message that carries the generation options.
The error came from `requireStrictCodec`, which throws when the codec mode is not strict.
Call `postprocess(parts.join(''))` once at the end, not per fragment.
The regular expression `/\u200b/g` removes zero-width spaces from the source.
Wrap the read in a try block, because the file may not exist on first launch.
The settings object is frozen, so writing to it throws in strict mode.
Guard the call with `typeof fn === 'function'` before invoking it.
The test asserts that the injected style element count stays at one after two renders.
Move the abort listener into a finally block, otherwise it leaks on the success path.
The loop skips empty pieces so that a double newline does not produce an empty request.
Iterate the catalog synchronously, since reading a small file at boot is cheaper than an await chain.
The reducer mutates the array it receives, which breaks the memoised selector downstream.
Return early when the identifier is already installed and the size matches.
Three things remain: verify the checksum, register the second slot, and document the settings file.
The plan is short: measure first, then decide whether a bigger model is worth the memory.
Order matters here: normalise the source, split it into sentences, translate each, then clean the punctuation.
Candidates are the small quantised model, the full precision one, and a larger multilingual model that needs more memory.
Two knobs are exposed: the repetition penalty and the maximum number of new tokens.
Remaining risks: the mirror may rate limit, the disk may fill, and the user may switch model mid-sentence.
Steps one and two are done; step three needs the browser to be open, which I cannot do from here.
The settings page groups model selection, the glossary, and the repair switch into one card each.
Accept either an absolute path, a file URL, or a data URL for the input image.
Before shipping, confirm three facts: the package declares a bundle manifest, the repository is old enough, and the description matches the code.
The bug is subtle: `JSON.parse` throws on a file that starts with a byte order mark, and the message only says unexpected token.
Because the panel and the plugin page read the same file, editing a term in one place must show up in the other without a reload.
The downloader writes to a partial file, verifies the checksum, then renames it, so a crash mid-transfer never leaves a half file behind.
I expected the smaller model to be faster, but at full precision it answered in three hundred milliseconds against five hundred for the quantised one.
The slot contract says a replacement must use a lower priority number and must keep access to the original text, so the panel always offers a way back to the English.
If the same sentence appears twice in a session, the second request is served from memory in under a millisecond.
The mirror answered where the primary endpoint failed, which is why the downloader takes a list of endpoints instead of a single base address.
Nothing leaves the machine: the weights are local, the runtime is local, and the only network call is an optional model download the user starts by hand.
A wrapped paragraph arrives as five short lines, and translating each line separately loses the connection between them, so the lines are joined before the splitter runs.
The failure was silent: the configuration declared with the wrong schema library made the plugin load and then do nothing, with no error in the log.
